fusions.name: Echo Tine
fusions.desc: Flicks a ringing note off the tines into the first enemy it meets for 3 resonating damage. It echoes on to 2 more enemies within 4 tiles for 50% of the damage.

fusions.name: Shrill Ring
fusions.desc: Strikes the tines together, dealing 12 resonating damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning them for 1 second.

fusions.name: Held Pitch
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 3 tiles in place for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Answering Note
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a note rings off the tines and strikes the nearest enemy within 6 tiles for 6 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
